key_insight: Thermal spray and PVD coatings are positioned as key enablers for greener aviation by improving component durability, efficiency, and service life while supporting net-zero goals.
engineering_relevance: For aerospace engineers and coating developers, the roadmap identifies high-impact research and deployment paths to reduce fuel use, extend maintenance intervals, and integrate advanced coating processes into sustainable aircraft systems.
method: Roadmap review of 20 focused subsections from invited domain specialists
Synthesis of current status, technical challenges, and R&D recommendations
Highlights AI-enabled process optimization, coating design, and integration
evidence_signal: The abstract is a perspective roadmap rather than an experimental study, so its evidence is expert consensus and field synthesis instead of new quantitative validation.
watch_item: Implementation will depend on scaling coatings without compromising aerospace qualification, reliability, or cost-effectiveness.
paper_title: Innovative Coatings for a Greener Sky: The 2026 Strategic Roadmap for Thermal Spray and PVD Coatings
